name: MVSplat
plain: MVSplat (Chen et al.): 3D Gaussian splats and depth from several posed, calibrated images in one pass; saves a 3DGS .ply. MIT.
summary: MVSplat (Chen et al. 2024): feed-forward 3D Gaussian splatting and depth from posed, calibrated images. A UniMatch CNN and multi-view swin transformer feed a plane-sweep cost volume (all other views), refined by 2D U-Nets with cross-view attention into every view's depth; a Gaussian head predicts one Gaussian per pixel (opacity, scale, rotation, degree-4 SH) in the given world frame (`result.gaussians`, `.save("scene.ply")`). Forward pass only: no renderer.

papers.title: MVSplat: Efficient 3D Gaussian Splatting from Sparse Multi-View Images

licence_notes: Only the RealEstate10K checkpoint is shipped (MIT code and weights); the ACID checkpoint has the same architecture.
task_io: Input: several images of one scene (posed and calibrated for multi-view stereo, unposed otherwise). Output: depth maps and, where the model predicts them, cameras and 3-D points.

variants.name: mvsplat-re10k

training_data.name: RealEstate10K (camera trajectories of YouTube real-estate videos)

licence.training_note: RealEstate10K (YouTube videos, camera poses from ORB-SLAM; research use per its release), the backbone initialised from UniMatch (GMDepth, ScanNet).

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model

original16.protocol: median of 5 after 3 warm-up, uint8 CUDA input, original code at the pinned commit, torch.no_grad; peak = max over the first call and the timed calls
original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); donydchen/mvsplat@01f9a28edb5e EncoderCostVolume, long side 256

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5
portable.note: measured on 45b0e4f0 with the cudnn_hacc per-call workspace change of 600d8c2c

kernels.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5
kernels.note: measured on 45b0e4f0 with the cudnn_hacc per-call workspace change of 600d8c2c

quality.title: DTU scans 1, 9, 24, 33, 75, view 24 + 7 sources, AbsRel / delta1 %
quality.protocol: 640x512 crops, the 7 most co-visible views as sources; GT = depth rendered from the structured-light points. AbsRel / delta1 over GT pixels, after per-image median scaling unless the model takes the cameras (calibrated MVS: cameras, error in mm; PatchMatchNet also the depth range 425-935 mm, MVSAnywhere its own range from the camera baselines).

original16.note: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); donydchen/mvsplat@01f9a28edb5e EncoderCostVolume, long side 256

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.02 and p99 <= 0.25 (absolute error of the output `depth`).
